name: MAIK
source:
A mysterious God that Master and his survivor group in Ehime all revere.

[spoiler]MAIK is an artificial intelligence created by Nyoro's Dad, which determined that in order to save life on Earth it must control the human race and subjugate them of their emotions. MAIK chose the Go-Getters Club as "Shepherds" that would lead the "Sheep", due to their intolerance to the emotion-suppressing nano-machines.

MAIK is composed of 3 different personalities: the main MAIK personality, the Yuki personality that defies MAIK, and a third personality implanted into Pielope.[/spoiler]
